QUOTE: Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` plus both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... Define only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`. Then ... forward through two function pointers. Call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, but it never says the two are mutually exclusive; the nearest claim is that the check forbids `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` alongside the macros.
